audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Trundle / Trundle / Trundle / Skill / Trundle / Trundle / Skill. The mirror audit already set its chart to Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas, matching the packet — so this page currently contradicts the Trundle page on six of seven rows.
audit.why: The content whys on this page already argue the mirror's version: whys[1] 'one chain into W rotation outpaces his Q bite', whys[4] 'the matchup-defining moment', whys[5] and whys[6] both give Sylas the item stages. Sylas 52.99% over 134 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 to the packet and mirror chart as matched full+content pairs, with ratings raised to follow.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is generic boilerplate, and no field anywhere gives Subjugate's cooldown or its doubling behaviour.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80 at 650 range and the steal DOUBLES over the following 4 seconds. Hijack is 80/55/30. So you cast his own resist-drain more often than he does, and breaking away from his cast early halves what he takes.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d, restating the mirror's cooldown pairing rather than re-deriving it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frozen Domain is described in three fields as nothing but a 'move-speed zone' or 'move-speed bubble'.
audit.why: Riot text: it grants Attack Speed, Move Speed, AND increased healing from ALL sources while he is on it. The healing amplification is the reason extended trades on his zone go badly, and it is the half the page omits.
audit.corrected: Fight him off the domain. On it, every point of his sustain — King's Tribute, lifesteal, potions — is amplified. 18s at rank 1, 750 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: King's Tribute is never mentioned on the page at all, and report[8].t's 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' is left unexplained.
audit.why: He heals for a percent of the MAXIMUM health of every enemy unit that dies near him — that includes the minion wave, so he sustains for free all lane without spending anything. The percentHealth flag also means stacking raw resistances reads the exchange wrong.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds is not a late-game luxury here, it is what makes the poke you land stay landed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp is called 'his Q bite' with no cooldown, range, or cast tell.
audit.why: 3.5 seconds, 300 range, and it is an AUTO-ATTACK RESET — so his burst opens with an attack animation, not an ability cast. The wind-up is the cue to step back, which is the opposite of waiting to see a spell go off.
audit.corrected: Written into whys[0]. Also note the page overstates the sap: Chomp takes attack damage, while Petricite Burst's bonus is magic damage, so the passive is not weakened the way 'early' claims.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (Q text, cd, range, autoReset flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull refer to losing 'no stun' with both E charges spent.
audit.why: Abscond/Abduct is a dash with a recast pull in Riot's text; no hardCC flag. The mirror auditor removed the same 'phantom stun'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice has no numbers anywhere despite being called 'his only out'.
audit.why: 21/19.5/18/16.5/15 at 1000 range — the longest cooldown in his kit by a wide margin, and a genuine window when it is down.

notes: Straightforward mirror restatement: the Trundle page had already been set to Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Skill / Sylas / Sylas / Sylas and this page still read Trundle on six of seven rows, so the two directions were rendering opposite answers. Moved as one group with ratings. Best unstated mechanic: Frozen Domain grants increased healing from ALL sources, not just move speed — three fields called it a 'move-speed zone', which is exactly the wrong reason to avoid it. King's Tribute was absent entirely despite being free lane-long sustain off dying minions. Left deliberately alone: whether Abscond dashes through Pillar of Ice terrain. The mirror auditor flagged the same question and neither Riot's text nor the flags settle it, so nothing on this page asserts it in either direction. Also unresolved: diff still reads TRICKY 7/10 over a chart that now gives Sylas five of seven rows — I did not change it here because the mirror gave no difficulty guidance.
